ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal lobe tips versus 65% low-intensity black pixels across the medial and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions on the distal 1/3 of both lobes. Left lobe exhibits a larger white field with internal black speckling. Right lobe white field is smaller and more concentrated at the tip. Central 2/3 of fluke is predominantly solid black with sparse white punctate spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with prominent serrations. Left lobe shows moderate-frequency low-amplitude undulations. Right lobe shows high-frequency irregular peaks, including a distinct notch-like indentation mid-lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep tapering to acute distal tips. The trailing edge follows a generally concave path from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular clusters visible on the far right distal tip, consistent with barnacle colonization. Punctate white spots scattered across the central black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel white linear scratches (rake marks) observed on the left lobe, originating in the black region and extending into the white distal field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks on the left lobe and localized barnacle scarring on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent high-intensity white circular spot located in the lower-central black region near the peduncle junction.
